import re,sys,yaml,json,importlib.metadata as md
from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator
s=open('_handoff/batch-o0/HANDOFF-P2S4-G2-REVIEWED.md',encoding='utf-8').read()
blk=re.search(r'```yaml\n(.*?)\n```', s, re.S).group(1)
doc=yaml.safe_load(blk)
sch=json.load(open('schema/handoff.schema.json',encoding='utf-8')); sch.pop('$id',None)
errs=sorted(Draft202012Validator(sch).iter_errors(doc), key=lambda e: list(e.absolute_path))
print('loader        : CPython %s, jsonschema %s, Draft202012Validator' % (sys.version.split()[0], md.version('jsonschema')))
print('document      : _handoff/batch-o0/HANDOFF-P2S4-G2-REVIEWED.md (embedded yaml block)')
print('structural    : %d error locus/loci' % len(errs))
for e in errs[:10]: print('   %-16s %s' % (e.validator, '/'.join(str(p) for p in e.absolute_path) or '(root)'))
print('verdict       : %s' % ('accepted' if not errs else 'rejected'))
sys.exit(0 if not errs else 1)
